## About this project · Sobre este proyecto

This site collects three complementary, fully reproducible analyses of hospitalizations for **endocrine, nutritional and metabolic diseases (ICD-10 E00–E89)** in Chile, based on the public **GRD (Grupos Relacionados de Diagnóstico)** and **DEIS hospital-discharge** data. Each report is a self-contained, peer-review-ready document with publication-quality figures (1200 dpi) and composite "graphical summary" figures.

*Este sitio reúne tres análisis complementarios y reproducibles de las hospitalizaciones por enfermedades endocrinas, nutricionales y metabólicas (CIE-10 E00–E89) en Chile, a partir de los datos públicos del sistema GRD y de egresos hospitalarios del DEIS.*

## Data & methods · Datos y métodos

- **Source:** Chilean Ministry of Health — GRD (Grupos Relacionados de Diagnóstico) and DEIS public hospital-discharge records.
- **Population:** hospitalizations with a primary diagnosis of ICD-10 **E00–E89**.
- **Period:** 2010–2024 (spatiotemporal) · 2019–2024 (outcomes & networks).
- **Software:** Python (pandas, NumPy, statsmodels, scikit-learn, NetworkX, GeoPandas, libpysal/esda, Matplotlib/Seaborn) rendered with [Quarto](https://quarto.org).

Raw GRD/DEIS data are **not redistributed** in this repository (large, publicly available from the source). See the `.qmd` source for full, reproducible analysis code.
